messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: Critical - GPU decode node OOM (streaming) impacting /v1/generate routes. Paging ryan_oncall for urgent triage.
ryan_oncall: Ack. I'm on it, moving to #incidents-bridge. Any initial customer impact?
jess_custsuccess: Multiple customers reporting 502s and dropped streams since ~22:45 UTC, some with partial tokens. CS is getting 3-4 tickets/min.
maya_sre: Seeing repeated CUDA OOM logs on decode pods: 'CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate 1.2G'. Node kubelet restarted container twice, now in CrashLoopBackOff on node gpu-24.
eli_runtime: Logs show runaway generation on a small fraction of requests — client-provided max_tokens headers sometimes set to huge values (e.g., 500k) due to malformed client. Parser didn't clamp. KV cache grows -> OOM.
ryan_oncall: Okay, immediate mitigations: 1) isolate node 24 from scheduler, 2) apply emergency routing rule to send traffic away from gpu-24, 3) enforce per-request max_tokens cap (512) at the ingress layer, 4) fail open to compact-cpu model variant for routes with suspicious headers.
maya_sre: Isolating node now (cordon + drain). Eviction in progress.
infra-bot: Node gpu-24 cordoned by maya_sre at 22:53 UTC. Pods evicted: decode-runtime-7f6d.
eli_runtime: Pushed ingress rule to clamp X-Client-Max-Tokens header to 512 (hotpatch) and a rate-limit for /v1/generate  -> 10 rps per token-streaming-route. Config snippet: ```- match: /v1/generate
  actions:
    - clamp_header: {name: X-Client-Max-Tokens, max: 512}
    - rate_limit: {requests_per_second: 10}
```
ryan_oncall: Good. Also toggled route fallback to model: gptx-compact-cpu for any request with header > 512 or missing model affinity. That will reduce GPU load.
support-ops: Noted, updating incident page and CS templates. Drafting quick customer note: "We detected high token requests causing OOMs; we've throttled and routed affected requests to fallback models to restore service. We'll follow up."
jess_custsuccess: Sending to top impacted customers now. Asking for ETA to full recovery so they can inform execs.
maya_sre: After cordon+drain, node gpu-24 is offline for maintenance. Pod restarts on other nodes trending down, GPU memory pressure dropping ~60%. No further OOMs in last 4 minutes.
eli_runtime: Observed some request drops during the hotpatch window due to immediate enforcement. Telemetry: dropped requests peaked at 180/min at 22:54 and are now ~5/min. Token median per-request dropped from 18k -> 64.
ryan_oncall: Good containment. Next actions: 1) Reproduce malformed header case in staging and add validation (PR queued), 2) Add unit to routing to autoreject any token count > 10k at LB (longer-term), 3) Rotate node and perform kernel logs collection for gpu-24. Assignments: eli -> runtime hotfix PR (cli + ingress validation), maya -> node postmortem + kernel dump, jess -> customer comms + CS follow-ups.
eli_runtime: Creating PR now: runtime will reject malformed max_tokens and inject safe defaults. Link: https://git.internal/r/runtime/PR-842 (hotfix branch).
maya_sre: Collected kernel logs and dmesg from gpu-24. Sending to SRE S3: s3://redwood-ops/incident-1708509999/gpu-24-dmesg.log
support-ops: CS templates sent. Customers who saw errors are receiving the initial note.
ryan_oncall: Status update for Execs in 15. Current status: containment successful, node isolated, ingress clamp + fallback applied, customer impact reduced. Estimating full recovery in 45-60m pending node remediation.
jess_custsuccess: Thx. Will ping once exec note is out.
maya_sre: Post-eviction, cluster stable. Scheduling node bake and full OS/kernel upgrade before bringing back. Will not rejoin until validated.
eli_runtime: Merged hotfix to staging, deploying to prod canary (5% traffic) in 10m. Hotfix ensures max_tokens header parsed as int, clamps to safe ceiling, and logs offending client IDs for followup.
ryan_oncall: Excellent. After canary looks good we'll roll to 100% and then uncordon node replacements. Keep CS and oncall looped.
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity lowered to SEV-2 at 23:30 UTC — service degraded but mitigated.
jess_custsuccess: Customers updated; a few want a postmortem. I'll coordinate.
ryan_oncall: Call wrap: we'll do a blameless postmortem tomorrow. For now, keep page for any regression. Great work everyone. :thumbsup:
